profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at National Grid
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer, I am excited to be on a journey with limitless learning opportunities. Experimenting with new ideas and pushing myself toward further growth is something that’s always been a part of me. I love solving problems, am driven by efficiency, and have a knack for interpretation. 

A “people person” by nature, I have extensive client-facing experience. I see myself continuing this journey in a collaborative work environment to be part of turning unbounded ideas into reality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on MERN application providing user interface for testing wireless devices.
• Maintained legacy software while developing new version from scratch.
• Collaborated with teammates to choose technologies for new version, such as Redux vs Context.
• Refactored GraphQL API to implement a Mongoose model.
• Leveraged gRPC and REST APIs to communicate with and configure various test instruments.
• Participated in agile development methodologies with daily scrum and two-week sprints.

positions.title: Server/Wedding Attendant/Captain/Bartender
positions.description:
Bartender (December 2015 - March 2020)
• Manage complete bar set-up and break-down for each individual event.
• Uphold legal and company serving standards in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.

Banquet Captain (December 2014 – December 2018)
• Oversaw a staff of 10-15 servers by communicating directions and responsibilities. 
• Maintained company standard operating procedures while sustaining individuality of each event.

Wedding Attendant (February 2014 – March 2020)
• Serve as dedicated point of contact for client to ensure needs and expectations are exceeded.
• Communicate closely with event specialists and management to maintain a timeline and respond to changes.

Server (May 2012 – March 2020)
• Provide exemplary customer service for private functions of up to 900 guests.
• Facilitate transitions between different events, such as wedding ceremonies to receptions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
• Completed over 500 hours of coursework and four projects in a 12-week immersive program.
• Met project requirements in 4 business days and continued to improve them over time.

Project Four - Packing Up Pennies
• Developed a full-stack application for calculating vacation budgets.
• Built front end using React.js, back end using Express.js and MongoDB.

Project Three: Talk to the Duck
• Worked with a team to build full-stack blog application with a software developer theme.
• Utilized agile project management, scrum methodology, and pair programming for group workflow.

Project Two:  Plots & Pots
• Built full-stack application using JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Handlebars, Bootstrap for front end. 
• Developed back end with Ruby on Rails & PostgreSQL, later rebuilt with Express.js & MongoDB.

Project One: Tic Tac Toe
• Built front-end of a single-page application game using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX.
• Managed separate concerns through modularization.

positions.title: Server and Bartender
positions.description:
• Served food and beverage for private events and in a casual dining room setting.
• Stocked bar, received and reviewed liquor orders, and organized storage space.

positions.title: Catering Coordinator
positions.description:
• Managed all internal conference catering at the Museum of Science. 
• Supported external sales and operations teams with administrative and financial duties.
• Organized, prepared for, and attended weekly meetings and tastings.

positions.title: Housekeeping Department Intern
positions.description:
•	Interned for a contractor overseeing the housekeeping departments at three Hyatt hotels. 
•	Alternated time between operational and HR positions, including floor supervisor and office management.
•	Compiled monthly reports for review by both the company and the client. 
•	Managed weekly inventory by tracking supply counts, adjusting par quantities, and receiving shipments.

positions.title: Server
positions.description:
• Processed several orders at a time and ensured proper timing for all food and beverages. 
• Provided in-depth knowledge of all menu items and designed meals upon request.

positions.title: English Teacher
positions.description:
• Created and taught original lessons for intermediate to advanced level adult students.
• Assessed incoming students' language ability and assigned them to classes accordingly.
• Organized cultural events, activities, and clubs for students.

positions.title: Hostess/Server/Bartender
positions.description:
• Prioritized outstanding service for customers at an upscale entertainment complex.
• Performed a comprehensive variety of operations including bartending, serving, coat check, hosting, etc.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Assisted with the launch of a non-profit organization that has now delivered over $10 million in technology products to classrooms.
• Performed routine clerical tasks including photocopying, data entry, processing outgoing shipments, testing software, research and administrative assistance, editing grants and press releases, etc.
